catalog.title: Release readiness dashboard
catalog.intro: Inspect releases and the complete dependency inventory. Optional OSV lookup and report export run only after an explicit user action; build, signing, publishing, and deletion remain unavailable.
catalog.refreshFailed: The inspection could not be refreshed.
catalog.disabledIntro: Consent-gated OSV lookup and user-chosen report export are available, but build, signing, and publishing commands remain disabled.
catalog.safeBoundaryText: OSV receives only approved package coordinates. Export writes only the file you select. No signing key, command execution, upload, publish, or deletion capability is available.
catalog.workspaceHint: Select the Minecraft Server Hub source folder to inspect. The folder is never modified.
catalog.nativeOnly: Available in the Windows Developer Tools app
catalog.workspaceInvalid: Select a valid Minecraft Server Hub workspace.
catalog.artifactHistoryIntro: Compare up to five signed release artifacts without modifying them.
catalog.releasePlanIntro: A read-only execution order derived from the current evidence. No command runs from this screen.
catalog.dependencyIntro: Build a local supply-chain inventory from four lockfiles. Nothing is sent online unless you review and approve the OSV request.
catalog.offlineAdvisoryTitle: Online vulnerability lookup has not run
catalog.offlineAdvisoryText: Review the exact OSV request before sending package coordinates.
catalog.noDataTransmitted: No package data has been transmitted in this session.
catalog.searchPackages: Search name, version, license, or component
catalog.onlineLookupIntro: The fixed OSV API receives only unique ecosystem, name, and version triples after you explicitly approve.
catalog.consentLabel: I reviewed the fields above and approve sending these package coordinates to OSV.
catalog.nativeScanOnly: The online lookup runs only in the installed Windows Developer Tools app.
catalog.noKnownVulnerabilities: OSV returned no known vulnerabilities for this exact inventory.
catalog.cacheValid24h: Results are cached locally for 24 hours by request digest.
catalog.policyIntro: Choose how license uncertainty and vulnerability findings affect release gates. Saved locally on this PC.
catalog.exportsIntro: Save the current inventory as an industry-standard SBOM or audit-friendly CSV. Exporting never starts a build or publish action.
catalog.check_manifestVersion: App, artifact, and manifest versions match
catalog.check_remoteVersion: Official feed version matches this project
catalog.check_dependencyIntegrity: Dependency sources and integrity metadata are safe
catalog.check_bundlePerformance: Production bundle stays within performance budgets
catalog.check_qualityEvidence: Quality evidence matches the current source
catalog.detail_verified: The installer signature is valid for the configured public key.
catalog.detail_verificationFailed: The installer signature could not be verified.

deferred.loadingHint: This section loads safely as it approaches the screen to keep startup responsive.
deferred.failedHint: Other inspection results remain available. Reload the app to try this section again.

operationsNavigator.title: Operations navigator
operationsNavigator.intro: Open a developer center directly. Deferred centers are activated before focus moves, so they cannot be skipped by a long scroll.

commandPalette.title: Command palette
commandPalette.intro: Search safe navigation, filtering, and read-only inspection commands from the keyboard. Build, signing, publishing, and deletion are never included.
commandPalette.refreshHint: Inspect the current workspace again in read-only mode.
commandPalette.showProblemsHint: Open release gates and show only warning and blocker checks.
commandPalette.showAllHint: Open release gates and restore every check.
commandPalette.chooseWorkspaceHint: Select another Minecraft Server Hub source workspace for read-only inspection.
commandPalette.noResults: No safe command matches this search.

evidence.title: License evidence center
evidence.intro: Collect exact local package manifests, LICENSE, NOTICE, COPYING, and author files for review items. Nothing is downloaded, uploaded, or changed.
evidence.notRunTitle: Local evidence has not been collected
evidence.notRunBody: Run the local scan to connect each review item to the files already present in node_modules or the Cargo cache.
evidence.search: Search package, license, component, or file
evidence.noMatches: No evidence item matches these filters.
evidence.noFiles: No matching local license file was found.
evidence.localBoundary: Only local package metadata and evidence-file hashes are returned. Absolute cache paths and file contents are not exposed.
evidence.reasonComplete: Exact manifest and local evidence files found
evidence.reasonManifestMissing: Exact package manifest is not installed or cached
evidence.reasonVersionMismatch: Installed manifest version differs from the lockfile
evidence.reasonLicenseMismatch: Manifest license differs from the lockfile
evidence.reasonIntegrityMismatch: Cached Cargo archive does not match the lockfile checksum
evidence.reasonFileMissing: Exact manifest found, but no LICENSE or NOTICE file was found
evidence.reasonNpmNoRestriction: No npm OS or CPU restriction
evidence.reasonNpmCompatible: npm OS and CPU conditions include Windows x64
evidence.reasonNpmOsCpuExcluded: npm OS and CPU conditions exclude Windows x64
evidence.reasonCargoUnknown: Cargo.lock does not preserve target cfg conditions; no applicability is guessed
evidence.gateNotRun: Local license evidence has not been collected
evidence.gateComplete: Local evidence · {complete}/{total} complete · {files} files · {verified} archives verified · {excluded} host-excluded gaps
evidence.gateCoverage: Local evidence · {complete} complete · {partial} manifest only · {missing} missing · {mismatch} mismatched · {actionable} actionable · {unknown} target unknown · {excluded} host-excluded

review.recoveryIntro: Inspect automatic pre-restore copies without modifying them. Verified entries can be exported as .mshlicense files; internal recovery files are never restored directly.
review.recoveryRetention: The latest {limit} entries are shown. Export important recoveries before the history grows.
review.recoveryTruncated: The scan limit was reached; additional files were not read.
review.noRecoveries: No pre-restore recovery has been created for this dependency inventory.
review.recoveryExportHint: Creates a verified external backup without changing the active ledger.
review.recoveryInvalidReason: This file cannot be exported because integrity verification failed.
review.recoveryNotLoaded: Recovery history is available in the installed Windows app.
review.title: License review register
review.intro: Record who reviewed each uncertain or reciprocal license, the decision, and the evidence-based reason. Records are bound to the exact dependency metadata and stay on this PC.
review.search: Search package, license, component, or reviewer
review.noMatches: No review item matches these filters.
review.evidenceCargo: Declared in the local Cargo registry manifest
review.evidenceMissing: Exact Cargo manifest is not in the local registry cache
review.rationalePlaceholder: State what was checked, obligations, and why this decision is safe.
review.exportIntro: Exports all current items, including pending entries, without workspace paths.
review.validationHint: Choose a decision, enter a reviewer, and provide at least 8 characters of reasoning.
review.staleHint: Stale records never satisfy a release gate.
review.historyIntro: Append-only events are hash-linked. Returning an item to pending adds a reset event instead of deleting history.
review.noLedgerHistory: No decision event has been recorded yet.
review.ledgerError: No saved decision is being used. Resolve the storage or integrity error, then reload.
review.ledgerBackupIntro: Export the exact hash-chained ledger or verify a .mshlicense file before a forward-only restore. Older and diverged histories never overwrite this PC.
review.restoreReady: This backup only adds verified history and can be restored safely.
review.restoreBlocked: Restore is blocked because this backup is identical, older, or has diverged from the current ledger.
review.restoreConfirm: I verified this backup and understand that the current ledger will first be copied to the local recovery folder.
review.noRecoveryNeeded: No previous ledger required a recovery copy.

quality.title: Test & quality evidence center
quality.intro: Matches explicitly run type checks, tests, Rust validation, and UI smoke evidence to the current source fingerprint. Opening this screen never runs tests.
quality.runRequired: No quality evidence matches the current source.
quality.historyIntro: Minimal summaries from the latest eight runs on this PC. Logs and paths are not stored.
quality.noHistory: No previous quality evidence is available for comparison.
quality.coverageGaps: Some coverage targets are not met.

bundle.title: Performance budget & bundle center
bundle.intro: Inspect the latest local production bundle without running a build. Compare entry cost, compressed totals, lazy chunks, and their largest source modules.
bundle.noBaseline: No baseline has been saved on this PC.
bundle.baselineSaved: Current build saved as the local baseline.
bundle.buildRequired: Run the production build again before using this result as release evidence.
bundle.suggestionText: Keep the entry below budget and load server tabs, dialogs, and language catalogs only when needed. Hover or keyboard focus may preload likely next screens.

cargoApplicability.applicable: Included in Cargo's locked, offline Windows x64 dependency graph
cargoApplicability.excluded: Excluded from Cargo's locked, offline Windows x64 dependency graph
cargoApplicability.unavailable: Cargo metadata was unavailable; applicability is not guessed

windowsEvidence.ready: Exports applicable, excluded, and unknown license evidence with local SHA-256 hashes. It does not include file contents or absolute paths.
windowsEvidence.unavailable: Collect the current local license evidence before exporting the Windows x64 audit file.

licenseAudit.supplemented: The package source header is paired with the bundled canonical license text.
licenseAudit.noticesReady: Generate a package list with the complete canonical license text from the current evidence.
licenseAudit.noticesUnavailable: Collect current local evidence and resolve all applicable gaps before generating notices.
licenseAudit.verifyFailed: The audit JSON was rejected. It may be stale, malformed, or modified.

releaseEvidence.title: Release evidence pack
releaseEvidence.intro: Bundle the current inspection, signed release, dependencies, bundle budget, quality results, and local license evidence into one tamper-evident file.
releaseEvidence.privacy: Absolute paths, commands, log output, reviewer names, rationales, and file contents are excluded.
releaseEvidence.confirm: I reviewed this preview and authorize creation of this exact evidence pack.
releaseEvidence.nativeOnly: Creating and verifying evidence files is available in the installed Windows app.
